answers.rationale: For a largely unscheduled recovery weekend, Kara repeatedly favors the stronger-rated, quieter, recovery-oriented lodging option over lower-cost convenience alternatives when the premium is tolerable. With only one Saturday obligation and a rental car, the 18-minute drive is not dominant; the 4.7 rating and quieter grounds make River Resort the best lead hold.
unsupported_assumptions: No explicit lodging budget was supplied, so this assumes the $294 rate is acceptable for this weekend.

answers.rationale: For an active kayaking and trail weekend, East Shore Lodge combines a short trail-meetup drive with the full pool, hot-tub, and fitness recovery bundle.
